default.title: Work Done
default.description: Work W = F d cos(theta), theta in radians

default.title: Hydrostatic Pressure
default.description: Pressure at depth p = rho g h

default.title: Buoyant Force
default.description: Buoyant force Fb = rho g V

default.title: SHM Displacement
default.description: x(t) = A sin(omega t + phi), angles in radians

default.title: Doppler Effect
default.description: f' = f * (v + vo)/(v - vs) (signs depend on direction)

default.title: Magnetic Force (moving charge)
default.description: F = q v B sin(theta), theta in radians

default.title: Magnetic Force (current-carrying wire)
default.description: F = B I L sin(theta), theta in radians

default.title: Binomial P(X=k)
default.expression: factorial(n) / (factorial(k) * factorial(n - k)) * p^k * (1 - p)^(n - k)

default.title: Linear Model (2 features)
default.description: y_hat = w1 x1 + w2 x2 + b

default.title: Bernoulli's Equation
default.description: Conservation of energy in a fluid. P + 0.5*rho*v^2 + rho*g*h = constant
default.expression: P + 0.5 * rho * v^2 + rho * g * h

default.title: Standard Deviation
default.description: Simple version for two numbers: sqrt(((x1-avg)^2 + (x2-avg)^2)/2)

default.title: Weber Number
default.description: Relative importance of inertia to surface tension. We = rho * v^2 * L / sigma

default.title: Beam Deflection (Center Load)
default.description: Simply supported beam. delta = (P * L^3) / (48 * E * I)

default.title: Laplace Pressure
default.description: dP = 2 * gamma / r (for bubble in liquid)

default.title: Haversine Distance (simple)
default.description: Distance between points. delta_sigma = 2 * arcsin(sqrt(hav(phi2-phi1) + cos(phi1)cos(phi2)hav(lon2-lon1)))

default.title: Parabola Vertex (x)
default.description: Vertex x-coordinate for ax^2 + bx + c

default.title: Quartic Polynomial Value
default.description: f(x) = ax^4 + bx^3 + cx^2 + dx + e

default.title: Cone Surface Area
default.description: A = πr(r + s), s = sqrt(r² + h²)

default.title: Sine Wave
default.expression: A * sin(2 * pi * f * t + phi)

default.title: Cosine Wave
default.expression: A * cos(2 * pi * f * t + phi)

default.title: Dot Product (3D)
default.description: v·u = x1 x2 + y1 y2 + z1 z2

default.title: Leaky ReLU
default.description: LeakyReLU(x) = x if x>=0 else αx

default.title: Distance Point to Line
default.expression: abs(a * x + b * y + c) / sqrt(a^2 + b^2)

default.title: Quadratic Vertex y
default.description: y_v = a x_v² + b x_v + c

default.title: Binomial Theorem (Term)
default.expression: factorial(n) / (factorial(k) * factorial(n - k)) * a^(n - k) * b^k

default.title: Distance Point to Plane
default.expression: abs(a * x + b * y + c * z + d) / sqrt(a^2 + b^2 + c^2)

default.title: Determinant 3x3
default.description: det = a(ei − fh) − b(di − fg) + c(dh − eg)
default.expression: a * (e*i - f*h) - b * (d*i - f*g) + c * (d*h - e*g)
